title: Staged qualification found scoped gains and unresolved operating boundaries
summary: The selected four-stage study supported continuing CPU wait retention, including causal diagnostics and fresh repository/document reserves. Several tighter or alternative regimes remained unresolved.
scope: Earlier pinned RTX 2080 Ti runtime, FP16 TP1. Eight functional cells included 7B AWQ, 1.5B and OPT125M, short/long contexts and selected graphs; separate cells do not qualify their cross-product.
limitations: Live output and runtime differences limit attribution. Answer-quality and production reliability gates were unmet. Earlier model support does not qualify current code.
decision: Keep causal controls, adverse cases and exact support boundaries as design knowledge. Do not carry old production or compatibility claims forward.

chart.metric: Workflow batch time saved versus ARC (%)
chart.caption: Distinct fixed-input studies, not pooled. Original conditional paired 95% intervals; higher is faster.
